title: Cohomology of flat scalar tensor is scalar Tor
statement: Under [lem-sfb-flat-scalar-tensor-resolution], for arbitrary scalar A-modules P,Q and any integer i, H^i(F(P)[0]⊗ᴸ_R F(Q)[0]) is isomorphic to F(Tor_{-i}(P,Q)) if i≤0, and to zero if i>0. Here F is exactly [def-sfb-flat-scalar-realization] and Tor uses the recorded projective-resolution convention [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules].

source.place: Tags 06YQ (bounded flat K-flat), 06YP (K-flat quasi-isomorphism) and 06YU (derived Tor)

proof.text: Apply the derived homology functor to the scalar tensor-resolution comparison. Derived homology of Q(K) is the ordinary homology of K.

Exactness of F identifies homology after F with F of homology. For i≤0, extending the scalar chain complex along n↦-n identifies its homology in degree i with homology in degree (-i).toNat; the projective-resolution computation is Tor in that degree.
For i>0 the extended complex has zero term, hence zero homology. An additive functor sends this zero object to a zero object.
